description: This file defines the FormattedTextArea class, which implements IAreaProvider to handle formatted text rendering within the MigraDoc document rendering system. It manages layout calculations, rendering info collection, and area management for text areas.

classes.name: FormattedTextArea
classes.description: Represents a formatted text area responsible for layout and rendering of text within MigraDoc documents.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Initializes formatting of the text area with a graphics context and performs layout formatting.

methods.name: InnerWidth
methods.description: Gets or sets the inner width of the text area, calculating inherent width if not explicitly set.

methods.name: InnerHeight
methods.description: Calculates the inner height based on content height and paddings.

methods.name: CalcInherentWidth
methods.description: Calculates the minimum inherent width needed to render the content.

methods.name: GetRenderInfos
methods.description: Returns the collection of render information objects.

methods.name: ContentHeight
methods.description: Calculates total height of the content based on render info.

methods.name: CalcContentRect
methods.description: Calculates the rectangle representing the content area.
